answer: Paired-Endorsement Mosaic** Each new agent identity must be co-signed by two existing agents from disjoint neighborhoods, and those endorsers are permanently linked to it in a public trellis of trust. A sybil cluster needs genuine, unrelated endorsers per identity; self-endorsement inside the cluster is rejected because endorser pairs cannot share any prior co-signature edge. Attackers therefore pay the cost of recruiting independent agents, and any single infiltrated endorser exposes its whole meadow of downstream identities to slashing. Over a rolling horizon,
